lattice_filter.rule: For reduced [uvw]: FCC half-integer steps iff u+v+w is even; BCC half-integer steps iff all three are odd; otherwise integer steps. Divide by gcd for unreduced indices.
lattice_filter.scope: Filter reported pure-x lattice-repeat candidates, not measured FFT wavelengths, spatial intervals or row motifs. Compatible means necessary closure only; geometry, mismatch and user choice still apply.

limitations: Finite-window geometric and structural hypotheses, not proof of exact translational symmetry.
Nearest-atom matches are bidirectional but not a constrained bijection.
No statistical confidence probabilities or automatic Burgers-vector conclusions are assigned.
Small structures cannot exclude a longer modulation outside their observable range.

long_band_observability.meaning: The exploratory long-wave band requires its lower bound to be below the observable upper bound. An unresolved band does not establish absence of long periodicity.

parameters.purpose: Identify possible short repeat units and possible longer structural modulation in the relaxed {110}||{111}, <110>-tilt FCC Ni boundary without assuming any repeat ratio; compare candidate continuous-periodic x cells with construction mismatch and size estimates while leaving final selection to the user.

notes: Measured motifs and construction-only rational matches are separate evidence; constructor candidates are not measured structural repeats.
Candidate options retain source ny/nz; review listed size-policy violations and periodic seams before choosing a new model.
Only validated FCC/BCC pure-x lattice-repeat coefficients enter measured options; measured feature lengths are not arbitrary construction counts.
No model was rebuilt, strained, or selected. Allowed fractional repeats are preserved for explicit user review.
